retrieval.semantics: Existing RETRIEVAL_RUN build_hnsw_edges and COCO_SCALE_RUN/SOP_SCALE_RUN build_candidates functions; k+1 then skip self, original row order, undirected union; all records in source global engineering partition

subsets.source: COCO full corpus, 116091 unique numeric image_id values
subsets.cutoff: Smallest whole-image prefix whose cumulative record count >= target; no image split; selected records restored to original corpus row order
subsets.full_exact: Reuse COCO_SCALE_RUN B_stage.json; no rerun. Historical receipt lacks separate index-add/search timings: report null, never infer them.

evaluation.K_selection: Frozen from COCO_SCALE_RUN/SOP_SCALE_RUN; no selection or recalibration
evaluation.components_order: record_id lexicographic; global graph before projection
candidate_comparison: same-entity candidate coverage and positive denominator
evaluation.scaling_fit: OLS log(Stage B wall seconds) on log(actual record count), each backend five points, including historical full exact

gates.action_on_mismatch: Stop and report independently observed values; never adjust toward budget
gates.method: Read cached components, align sorted IDs, compute contingency-table pair counts; compare exact counts and F1 rounded to six decimals

timing.stages: Each timed gate/B/C/D/comparison in a fresh process holding flock; stage wall/process_time and process peak RSS; B includes read/normalize, four-channel generation/merge, materialize/sort/parquet write
timing.subphases: image/text cache-read-normalize, index-add, search, python-union wall+CPU; nonembedding channels, materialize, write
timing.projection: Exact subscales sum((actual_n/580767)^2 * 6513.7); HNSW and C/D projected conservatively from frozen source receipts and observed RETRIEVAL_RUN/small-scale rates. Stop if accumulated + remaining projected exceeds 14400 or actual cumulative exceeds 14400.

verification.master: Opening and final complete porcelain must equal prescribed 23-line / 817-byte snapshot
